description: Recent insider transactions for a company (issuer) from SEC Form 4 / 4/A XML: reporter name, role and officer title, transaction date, code with plain-English meaning (P=open-market buy, S=sale, A=grant, M=option exercise, F=tax withholding, G=gift...), shares, price, value, acquired/disposed, shares owned after, direct/indirect, plus a summary of open-market buys vs sales. `limit` counts filings (each filing can hold several transactions).

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), CIK (320193 or 0000320193), or company name. Names must resolve unambiguously; use search_company first if unsure.

include_footnotes.description: Include footnote text (10b5-1 plan details, price ranges)

limit.description: Number of most recent Form 4 filings to parse

transaction_codes.description: Only these codes, e.g. ['P','S'] for open-market trades

name: get_insider_trades
title: Insider trades (Form 4)
